info.title: Grant Options Scanner Feed
info.description: Read-only access to the daily scanner snapshot. One endpoint, no auth.

get.description: Returns the most recent morning pipeline run: regime, candidates, trade proposals with Income/Opportunity modes and 0-100 scores, and validation results. Check generated_utc to confirm the data is from today before summarizing it as today's run.

generated_utc.description: When this snapshot was produced (UTC). If this is not today's date, the morning run failed and this is stale data.
